rca_of_the_issue: BUG 1 root cause was that Starlette encodes Content-Disposition as latin-1 by default, and Thai characters passing str.isalnum() slipped through the previous filename sanitiser. Fix uses `c.isascii() and c.isalnum()` for the legacy filename= parameter, and RFC 5987 quote() for the filename*=UTF-8'' extension — the two together satisfy every UA. BUG 2 root cause was that scipy.stats.alexandergovern divides by group variances, so when at least one usable group had zero within-group variance both statistic and pvalue came back NaN and JSONResponse then crashed on `float('nan')`. Fix filters usable groups by _has_variance() BEFORE calling the ANOVA, falls back to one-way F if the Welch-ANOVA still yields non-finite, and wraps the return in _json_safe() as a defence-in-depth sanitiser. Both fixes verified end-to-end (API + UI).
